intergarrītus , a, um, Part., from the obsolete intergarrio [inter-garrio],
I.prated or chattered between (post-class.): “dein pauculis verbis intergarritis (al. intergannitis),” App. Mag. p. 284, 38 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
